description: Use this when the user wants individual standings from a social doubles schedule and game scores. Counts wins, losses, draws, points for, points against, difference and win percent for up to 48 players and 288 scores. Accepts a generated schedule_request or an indexed schedule; unscored games stay pending. Does not use rating systems or governing tournament rules.

courts.description: Available courts, a whole number from 1 to 12, e.g. 2. Unfillable courts are left unused.

group_a.description: Optional group A names, e.g. ["Alex","Blair"]. Supply both groups; each player must be in one group.

items.description: Player name, up to 40 characters, e.g. Alex.

group_b.description: Optional group B names, e.g. ["Casey","Drew"]. Partners cross groups; unequal groups may be refused if balanced rests are impossible.

items.description: Player name, up to 40 characters, e.g. Alex.

players.description: 4 to 48 distinct player names, e.g. ["Alex","Blair","Casey","Drew"]. Names are limited to 40 characters.

items.description: Player name, up to 40 characters, e.g. Alex.

rounds.description: Number of rounds, a whole number from 1 to 24, e.g. 7.

seed.description: Repeatable seed, a whole number from 0 to 4294967295, e.g. 42. Defaults to 1; four players in one round enumerate ordered rotations before repeating (24 without groups, 16 with groups). Larger configurations use seeded bounded search.

players.description: 4 to 48 distinct player names, e.g. ["Alex","Blair","Casey","Drew"]. Names are limited to 40 characters.

items.description: Player name, up to 40 characters, e.g. Alex.

rounds.description: The schedule rounds, e.g. one round with one court.

sit_out.description: Indexes sitting out, e.g. [4]. Omit to calculate from matches.

schedule.description: The returned schedule_request, e.g. {players:["Alex","Blair","Casey","Drew"],courts:1,rounds:3,seed:42}, or a full indexed schedule JSON.

scores.description: Game scores, e.g. [{round:1,court:1,score_a:11,score_b:7}]. Ties count as draws; supply at least one score.

score_a.description: Team A points, a whole number 0 to 999, e.g. 11.

score_b.description: Team B points, a whole number 0 to 999, e.g. 7.
